about: Default presentation for brands (src/storefront/brand-registry.ts). A brand's admin settings (Storefront > Brands) always win; this fills what an admin has not set. slugs: the product brand slugs it covers (from supplier catalogues). logo: the square logo or icon, card: wide gift-card art; each an https:// address, or a storage path such as brands/mtn/logo.svg (served from file storage under <root>/platform/), or null. icon: the bundled fallback logo from the assets/BitoCard-Brand-Icons-500x500 pack, copied to the storefront as /brand-icons/<slug>.svg by node scripts/brand-icons.mjs and used when there is no upload or logo. Brands without a logo show their initials on their colour. Upload a folder of logos with npm run brands:logos -w @bitocard/api. art: the bundled card art from the assets/BitoCard-Gift-Card-Art pack, copied to the storefront as /brand-cards/<slug>.webp by node scripts/brand-cards.mjs and used when no card art was uploaded and card is null.
